about_the_game:
You are a simple peasant living in medieval times, working for your feudal lord. One day, you discover the recipe for brewing beer. This changes your life - improve your brewing skills, unlock new sales channels, and expand your product across growing territories. But be careful! The world that discovers beer will never be as peaceful as before.

Brew

Start with the simplest beer made from bread. Then unlock increasingly advanced brewing technologies.

Sell

At first, sell your beer hand-to-hand, then open sales points at markets and eventually establish your own tavern!

Expand

Buy premises and equipment. Hire assistants and automate production. Conquer new lands.

Fight

You’d be wrong to think the world won’t change after learning about beer. Public order will be disrupted. You and everyone else must be more careful at night.

Wishlist now!
